description: Test suite for group management functionalities in Mattermost, including group retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and synchronization with teams and channels.

methods.name: TestGetGroup
methods.description: Tests basic retrieval of a group and member ID restrictions based on view restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetGroupByRemoteID
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a group by its remote ID.

methods.name: TestGetGroupsByType
methods.description: Tests fetching groups filtered by source type.

methods.name: TestCreateGroup
methods.description: Tests creation of a new group and conflict handling.

methods.name: TestUpdateGroup
methods.description: Tests updating group details and handling invalid updates.

methods.name: TestDeleteGroup
methods.description: Tests deletion of a group and handling repeated deletions.

methods.name: TestCreateOrRestoreGroupMember
methods.description: Tests adding or restoring a group member.

methods.name: TestUpsertGroupSyncable
methods.description: Tests inserting, updating, and undeleting group syncables.

methods.name: TestUpsertGroupSyncableTeamGroupConstrained
methods.description: Tests constraints when associating groups with teams and channels.

methods.name: TestGetGroupSyncable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific group syncable.

methods.name: TestGetGroupSyncables
methods.description: Tests fetching all syncables for a group.

methods.name: TestDeleteGroupSyncable
methods.description: Tests deletion of a group syncable.

methods.name: TestGetGroupsByChannel
methods.description: Tests fetching groups associated with a channel.

methods.name: TestGetGroupsAssociatedToChannelsByTeam
methods.description: Tests fetching groups associated with channels under a team.

methods.name: TestGetGroupsByTeam
methods.description: Tests fetching groups associated with a team.

methods.name: TestGetGroups
methods.description: Tests fetching all groups with pagination.

methods.name: TestUserIsInAdminRoleGroup
methods.description: Tests whether a user has admin role within a group based on syncable scheme admin status.
